gaps.sentence: ___ her age, she still runs marathons.
gaps.explanation: 'In spite of' + noun (her age); the conjunctions would need a clause.

gaps.sentence: The rehearsals ran late; ___, the premiere itself went off without a hitch.
gaps.explanation: 'Nevertheless' = in spite of what was just said.

gaps.sentence: I know exactly what the risks are. ___, I'm going anyway.
gaps.hint: doing it in spite of risk

gaps.sentence: ___ the theory is elegant, the data simply don't support it.
gaps.explanation: 'Even though' grants the fact (the theory is elegant) before contradicting it.

gaps.sentence: ___ his salary, he earns royalties from three textbooks.
gaps.explanation: 'In addition to + noun' adds one source of income to another.

gaps.sentence: He spends money ___ it grew on trees.
gaps.explanation: 'As if it grew on trees' — the unreal comparison justifies the criticism.

gaps.sentence: ___ his leg was strapped up, the captain insisted on playing.
gaps.explanation: 'Even though' intensifies the concession before a full clause.

gaps.sentence: I will send the report today ___ you asked for it early.
